key_points: ADBE rose ~2.5-3% as part of a broad enterprise software rotation out of AI-hardware/chip stocks following calls to slow frontier AI development.
Catalyst is sector-level and external (AI pacing debate), not company-specific — does not alter ADBE's fundamental outlook or competitive position.
Rotation trades of this nature are historically short-lived and can reverse quickly if the AI-slowdown narrative fades or chip stocks rebound.
Prior-week mixed earnings results and Wall Street questioning of ADBE's growth trajectory remain the more relevant fundamental backdrop.
No new company-specific catalysts (guidance change, M&A, product launch, regulatory event) are present in this headline set.
